text_block_list.text:
From that day forward, Meisho Doto threw herself into practicing 
on her own.

Huff, huff, huff! 
O-one more time...!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
Huff, wheeze, hufff! 
I-I'm tired... No, I can't give up! I'm only just getting started...!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: Taking things head-on, without giving up――
I'm going. To make it. The best race everrrrrr～～!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: ――Uhyaaahhh?!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: Heh! Truly magnificent work, Doto!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
――And at long last, the day of the meet arrived! 
The stands were overflowing with Umamusume, spectators and competitors alike.
Did you hear? Doto's going up against Opera O in the 1800 meters! Apparently the theme is something like, "Myself and Doto, together in symphony"? Look, that's what the programme says!
text_block_list.name: Classmate A

text_block_list.text: A programme? Like it's a theatrical play? There's way too much to unpack there... Anyway, if Doto's the challenger, she's totally gonna mess up like usual.
text_block_list.name: Classmate B

text_block_list.text:
Today, let us perform the ultimate symphony! 
I am counting on you, Doto!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: Y-yes!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: Pheww. Huff! Laces, check... bib, check... and my tummy doesn't hurt, check! I'm going to give it my absolute best...!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
Who will claim victory in the 1800 meters?! 
The Umamusume are all lined up in the starting gates――and they're off!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text: ――Already entering the third corner! Slowly but surely, the standout star, T.M. Opera O, begins making her move to break away from the pack!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text:
(I can feel her coming up right behind me...! 
She's about to make her decisive move――!)
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
We're finally entering the home stretch! 
Coming around the outside, it's T.M. Opera O! T.M. Opera O surges ahead for the lead!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text: (There she is...!)
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: The finale of this grand tale, just like my Victory Road, has already been etched in destiny!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: ――Haaaaaahhhh!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text:
(S-she's pulling further and further away...! 
Opera O-san really is so a-amazi――)
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: ――Fwehh?!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
Wait, Meisho Doto has lost her footing――?! 
Did she trip?!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text: (Why...? Why right now, of all times? I really am just useless――)
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: "Not knowing when to give up is your true strength."
"Not knowing when to give up is your true strength."
...Ngh... Ra... Ra... raaaaaaaaagh!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: No, she regains her footing in a flash and sets her sights right back on Opera O! Only 200 meters remaining―― Will Doto overtake Opera O?!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text: (I'll catch up... I have to overtake her...!)
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: DAAAAAAHHHHHH——!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: They're neck and neck at the wire! T.M. Opera O! Meisho Doto! And the victor is―― T.M. Opera O!
text_block_list.name: Commentator

text_block_list.text:
Huff, huff... Huffff! 
I knew it... I couldn't beat her after all...
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
(Still... so many people watching us are smiling. 
Maybe... just maybe, I was able to be of some help to Opera O-san today.)
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: Ahh, the applause reverberates in my ears! The audience looks upon me in utter awe! EXCELLENT! My gratitude to one and all, thank you!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: However, I must direct the spotlight toward one without whom this stage would never be complete! Indeed, even I must applaud the indomitable spirit of Meisho Doto!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: Fwehhh?!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
Even my peerless brilliance could not extinguish her fire! 
Offer her your thunderous applause for co-starring in such a marvelous performance!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaahhhh!)

Wh-waaah! Th-thank you so much...?! 
Wait, whyyy?!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
Your sheer tenacity made you a rival most worthy! 
I knew you were the only choice, but let me proclaim it again――casting you was truly inspired!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: So... you didn't just pick me purely by accident?
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Come now, whatever are you implying? 
I shall be counting on you for our next stage as well, Doto!
text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O

text_block_list.text: Standing frozen in sheer disbelief, Meisho Doto was once more enveloped by the thunderous applause of the crowd.

That had me on the edge of my seat! I totally thought she was going to crash down! 
What a recovery! Way to go, Doto!
text_block_list.name: Classmate A

text_block_list.text:
Not a single Umamusume in the crowd dared laugh at her now. 
Unable to contain my excitement, I rushed straight down to meet her.

You came to watch me...? Thank you so, so much. 
It was really tough, but I'm just so glad I was able to run hard till the end. 
Ehehe...
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
You know... 
I feel like today's race was a huge step forward for me～.
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
She smiled as though she had not a single worry in the world―― 
Yet I knew all too well that beneath it all, her knees were covered in scrapes and bandages.

I knew how many countless times she had wiped away her tears. 
I knew how she had picked herself up and kept going when anyone else would have quit.
Huh? Wh-why are you saying something like that all of a sudden...?
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
If she truly wishes to change, she can without a shadow of a doubt. 
Because Meisho Doto is an Umamusume who will never, ever give up.
choice_data_list: ――I want to see how far you can go.
――I want to see how far you can go.

text_block_list.text: ...! Th-then... do you mean...!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
choice_data_list: I'd like you to be my trainee.

text_block_list.text: Hyawa! A-a-a-are you really, truly okay with someone like me?! R-re-really?!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: I... I, while I was running, I kept remembering what you told me!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
"Not knowing when to give up is your true strength." 
Those words felt like a precious blessing to me... 
That's why... um...!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
"Not knowing when to give up is your true strength." 
Those words felt like a precious blessing to me... 
That's why... um...!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text:
I-I think that maybe, just maybe, I can really change if I'm with you! 
S-so... please take good care of me from now on, Trainer-san!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto

text_block_list.text: (Crash!)
Hwaa?! O-oh nooo! I tripped! A-are you all right, Trainer-saaaaan?!
text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
